newsitem.title: TURKEY: Floods in southeast Turkey kill four.
newsitem.headline: Floods in southeast Turkey kill four.

text.p: Heavy flooding in the far southeast of Turkey has killed four people with another two missing feared dead, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Saturday.

It said two women were washed away while cleaning carpets on the side of a stream near Altinsu village in Hakkari province. Their bodies, together with those of two others were later found downstream, the agency said.

Two other people from the neighbouring village of Baglar were still missing, Anatolian said. The floods followed two days of heavy rain in Hakkari, which borders Iran and Iraq, and led to landslides blocking transport in the area.

Flooding in neighbouring northwest Iran killed seven villagers and derailed three carriages of a train on a railway connecting the provincial capital of Tabriz to Tehran, injuring 18 passengers, Tehran radio said on Saturday.
